news_items.headline: Corpay up 5.8% after boosting FY2026 guidance, expanding buybacks, and adding stablecoin payments via BVNK partnership
news_items.summary: Corpay raised FY2026 EPS guidance to $26.30–$27.10 (vs. consensus $25.78) and revenue guidance to $5.3B (vs. consensus $5.2B). The company also announced a buyback expansion and added stablecoin wallet + settlement capability through a BVNK partnership.

news_items.headline: Corpay Q1 revenue $1.26B (+25% YoY), cash EPS $5.80 (+29%); insider buying noted
news_items.summary: Corpay reported Q1 2026 revenue of $1.26 billion, up 25% year-over-year, and cash EPS of $5.80, up 29% YoY, both beating street estimates. Insider buying was observed alongside the earnings release.

news_items.headline: Corpay earnings call signals robust growth momentum in cross-border and automated payables
news_items.summary: Management highlighted continued adoption of automated payables and cross-border payment solutions as the primary growth drivers on the Q1 earnings call.

news_items.headline: Corpay FY2026 earnings guidance updated above consensus
news_items.summary: Corpay updated full-year 2026 EPS guidance to $26.30–$27.10 versus analyst consensus of $25.78, and revenue guidance to $5.3B versus consensus of $5.2B.

news_items.headline: Corpay M&A integration risk: Alpha, GPS, and Paymerang cost absorption in focus
news_items.summary: Analysts flag M&A integration as the primary risk — whether Corpay can absorb Alpha Group, GPS, and Paymerang efficiently without M&A and technology spending outpacing revenue growth.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Consensus from 12 analysts: 8% Strong Buy, 58% Buy, 33% Hold, 0% Sell. Mean price target $394.52 (range $343.40–$462.00); a separate aggregator cites $380.67. No specific upgrade/downgrade actions found in the last 7 days beyond the standing consensus.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 earnings reported approximately 2026-05-22: revenue $1.26B (+25% YoY), cash EPS $5.80 (+29% YoY), both above consensus. FY2026 guidance raised above street on both EPS and revenue. Next quarterly earnings date not found in search results.
